title: Distinguish consent from the lawful basis for processing
requirements:
- Refer to access policy based on lawful basis, purpose and consent where relevant
- Reword so consent is one mechanism of individual agency, not the primary basis for processing
- State in 4.3.4 that interfaces to foundational DPI carry or reference the consent or legal basis for health data crossing them
- Use granular, versioned consent or policy records
- Distinguish lawful basis, authorisation, consent where applicable, and individual rights
- Require sensitivity labelling and segmentation
- Apply the same distinction where AI governance is described in 5.2
- Define testable emergency-access conditions and explain limits of individual control
